rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for general hardships and difficult circumstances.

example.english: When facing adversity, don't give up so quickly.
example.traditional: 面對困難，唔好咁快放棄。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3

rows.note: Use this for the broader state of being in adverse circumstances, especially when stressing overcoming them.

example.traditional: 佢喺逆境中仍然保持冷靜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 jik6 ging2 zung1 jing4 jin4 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6

rows.note: Use this for the misfortune or calamity aspect of adversity rather than ongoing hardship.

example.english: That adversity left the whole family without support.
example.traditional: 嗰場不幸令成個家庭失去依靠。
example.jyutping: go2 coeng4 bat1 hang6 ling6 sing4 go3 gaa1 ting4 sat1 heoi3 ji1 kaau3

rows.note: Use this when adversity means severe suffering or hardship endured over time.

example.english: Everyone encounters adversity in life, but as long as we persevere, we will get through it.
example.traditional: 人生總會遇到苦難，但只要堅持，終會捱過去。
example.jyutping: jan4 sang1 zung2 wui5 jyu6 dou3 fu2 naan4 daan6 zi2 jiu3 gin1 ci4 zung1 wui5 ngaai4 gwo3 heoi3
